description: Sweep reuses its initial roster to skip missing named orchestrators before gauge and tick fleet queries, including with an interactive account and unrelated live specialists. One agent-list call serves both projects; exact output pins summary, host, and tick order. Exercises apply and dry-run paths without a real fleet.

home.config_toml:
[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"
[projects.sandbox2]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox2}}"
[accounts.nexus-seat]
kind = "claude"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{HOME}}"
interactive = true
command = "fake-nexus"
